units.source_text: 据我观察，先生和夫人是一对恩爱的夫妻。

en.t: As far as I could tell, Sensei and his wife were a loving couple.

units.source_text: 我没有在先生家里生活过，自然不了解更深入的情况，

en.t: Since I had never lived in Sensei's house, I naturally did not know the deeper details,

units.source_text: 但是先生和我在客厅时，有时候有事不叫女佣人，而叫夫人。

en.t: but when Sensei and I were in the sitting room, he would sometimes call his wife instead of the maid when he needed something.

units.source_text: 先生总是回头朝隔扇那边叫一声：“喂，静（夫人名字叫静）。”

en.t: Sensei would always turn toward the sliding screens and call, "Hey, Shizu" (his wife's name was Shizu).

units.source_text: 我觉得先生的声音很温柔。

en.t: To me, Sensei's voice sounded very gentle.

units.source_text: 夫人答应一声，走出来的样子也甚为贤淑。

en.t: The way his wife answered and came out was also very gentle and modest.

units.source_text: 有时先生留我吃饭，夫人也在座的时候，他们之间的恩爱就表现得更明显了。

en.t: Sometimes Sensei invited me to eat, and when his wife was also present, the affection between them became even clearer.

units.source_text: 先生常常带夫人去听音乐会、看戏。

en.t: Sensei often took his wife to concerts and plays.

units.source_text: 而且，在我的记忆中，他们夫妻至少有过两三次为期一周的旅行。

en.t: Moreover, as I remember it, the couple had taken trips of about a week at least two or three times.

units.source_text: 我现在还保存着先生从箱根给我寄来的风景明信片，以及去日光旅行时，寄给我的夹着一片红叶的信。

en.t: Even now I still keep the scenic postcard Sensei sent me from Hakone, and the letter he sent during his trip to Nikko with a single maple leaf tucked inside.
